text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- 18 workers killed in Valencia in ship fire caused by human error
- Mars Pathfinder starts to explore Mars tonight
- One of Ortega Lara's kidnappers took part in the killing of three civil guards.
EL MUNDO
- Error provokes death of 18 workers in a Valencia shipyard
- Spaceship arrives in Mars today, to show whether there was life on the red planet
- (Catalan Popular Party leader) Lacalle admits receiving party funding from (ex-financier) De La Rosa
DIARIO 16
- National alert. Fears of a possible (Basque separatist) ETA revenge act
- Tragedy in Valencia
ABC
- Tragedy in Valencia port
CINCO DIAS
- Bourse blows up all indices
- Tax on pension funds to improve in January
- Accident causes 18 deaths in Union Naval de Levante
EXPANSION
- Government authorises investment trusts to invest in non-listed firms
- Tax consultants agree on the need for fiscal reform
- Repsol abandons Seven Eleven franchise to set up its own chains of shops
- Agriculture Ministry criticises Brussels for raising mad cow alarm
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- In ten days Economy Ministry will start income tax rebate
- Brussels backtracks, denies Spain imported contaminated meat
- Argentaria offers 20 billion pesetas for Mexico's Banca Confia
- Private capital to enter (state national railway) Renfe's local and regional trains
